slides.header: Green roof? Summer is when you win the moss fight.
Why your roof grows a garden
slides.body: Moss needs moisture, shade, and something to grab onto. Western Oregon delivers all three, especially on north-facing slopes under the Doug firs.
It holds water against the surface like a wet sponge and pries shingle edges up as it grows. That is how a cosmetic problem becomes a leak.
High pressure strips the protective granules, takes years off the roof, and can void the warranty. Gentle removal plus treatment is the safe way.

slides.header: Why summer is the right time
slides.body: Treatments work best on a dry roof, with time to do their job before the rains return. Late spring through early fall is the window.
More sunlight on the roof, clear debris, flowing gutters, and a regular schedule. A treated roof stays clear longer.
